notes: Rifampicin time course (0-30 min) in MG1655 carrying pBR322-toxIN or empty pBR322. 0 min samples taken as the untreated baseline (treatment none, transcription not yet arrested); empty-vector 0 min is the control. toxIN origin not stated in the text, so genotype_class left empty for +toxIN (perturbed_genes toxI;toxN). Phase mid_exponential inferred from OD ~0.35/0.2 and sampling <=30 min after rifampicin. Temperature at sampling 30 C.
